messages:
oliver: opened a PR to adjust the streaming client headers and opt-in toolcalling flag: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-sdk/pull/4567 — it's a small rename (tool_calling -> tool_call) and adds an optional header `x-rdw-toolcall`. Tests pass locally and CI is green, but want a couple of SDK/runtime eyes before we merge. planning to merge in tomorrow's 10:00 PT minor bump window unless blockers. @maya @sam can you take a look?

maya: looking now, thanks for the heads up. quick skim — API change looks additive but the header name + flag rename might break some internal agents using the old param. sending a few comments on the PR.

sam: will review shortly. one ask: can you include a short migration note in CHANGELOG (just a line) so infra teams can grep for the header? also add a unit test asserting header is set when tool_call=true.

oliver: good call, will add a CHANGELOG line + test. also adding a compatibility shim: if `tool_calling` present, map to `tool_call` and emit a deprecation warn in logs for one release.

deploy-bot: CI: build passed — linux/amd64, macos/arm64, esm bundles. (run id: ci-789012) :white_check_mark:

chen: quick note from the Go client side — our bindings don't have the opt-in header yet. if we merge the change as-is, some Go customers might not get toolcall unless we push a shim. can we gate the header behind a feature-flag or add the shim oliver mentioned?

oliver: will add the shim and a small feature-flag opt-in in runtime config. plan: add compat shim + test by EOD, push update to PR. if no other objections, merge tomorrow.

maya: that sounds safe. once the shim is in, I'm fine approving. will re-check the PR after your update. :thumbsup:

sam: also please run a quick smoke test with the websocket streaming client (the new header should be propagated). a snippet that repros is handy, e.g.:

```bash
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "x-rdw-toolcall: true" \
  "https://api.redwood.example/v1/stream?model=redwood-large"
```

oliver: perfect, adding that curl example to the PR description and will attach smoke test results. thanks all, pinging when updated.

maya: thanks — appreciate the thoroughness.
